The '''1966–67 season''' was the 68th completed season of [[English Football League|The Football League]].

==Final league tables ==
The tables and results below are reproduced here in the exact form that they can be found at the [[RSSSF]] website<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1966-67.html |title=England 1966-67 |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=24 February 2010}}</ref> and in ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79'',<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref> with home and away statistics separated.

Beginning with the 1894–95 season, clubs finishing level on points were separated according to goal average (goals scored divided by goals conceded), or more properly put, goal ratio. In case one or more teams had the same goal difference, this system favoured those teams who had scored fewer goals. The goal average system was eventually scrapped since the 1976–77 season.

Since the [[Football League Fourth Division|Fourth Division]] was established in the [[1958–59 Football League|1958–59 season]], the bottom four teams of that division were required to apply for [[Re-election (Football League)|re-election]].<ref name=" Rothmans"/>
